mapper.sql: id, prescription_id, drug_code, drug_name, specification, unit, unit_price, quantity, item_amount, dosage, frequency, route
mapper.select: SELECT FROM prescription_item WHERE prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prescription_item (prescription_id, drug_code, drug_name, specification, unit, unit_price, quantity, item_amount, dosage, frequency, route) VALUES (#{item.prescriptionId}, #{item.drugCode}, #{item.drugName}, #{item.specification}, #{item.unit}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.itemAmount}, #{item.dosage}, #{item.frequency}, #{item.route})
